_about: How the domains lens reads a footprint's registered domains. Each registered domain of a controlled name is looked up as a name and its registration record read: an asset of record_types reached by a relation whose purpose is registration_purpose. registrar_labels are the record's relations to its registrar, and name_server_labels to its name servers. fields names the record's content fields. A domain is reported when its registration expired or expires within expiry_warning_days, when no registration is stored for it, when its status lacks every one of transfer_lock_statuses (compared without case, spaces or underscores; EPP and RDAP status codes as ICANN documents them), and, for review, when it is not signed with DNSSEC. Add values here, not in Go code.
